extracted.name: Cacio e pepe butter beans
extracted.description: Give butter beans the cacio e pepe treatment in this easy one-pan recipe. Creamy, cheesy and packed with black pepper, it's perfect for weeknights
ingredient_lines: 2 x 400g cans butter beans drained, reserving the liquid
olive oil, crusty bread and cooked greens to serve
instruction_lines: Melt the butter in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Stir in 1 tsp freshly ground black pepper and cook for 30 seconds-1 min until fragrant.

Tip in the butter beans and cheese, and stir until the cheese has melted. Pour in a spoonful of the reserved bean liquid at a time until the sauce has emulsified and is creamy. Remove from the heat and drizzle over a little olive oil, if you like. Serve with crusty bread and seasonal greens, if you like.
